entries.what_was_tested: Standalone paper-repository extraction, privacy, source integrity, numerical replay, document build and failure paths.
entries.methods: 49 deterministic tests in three interpreter modes; independent directory with supplied catalogues and matrices; all 30,000 original permutation-index digests and 780,000 candidate statistics replayed; 945 spatial deletions; 9 mass-bin weighted comparisons; 54 nominal t references and 3 cube summaries.
entries.results: Reproduction passed; maximum checked absolute numerical difference 4.217781679471955e-11. Both v12 PDFs reproduced byte-for-byte with the existing compiler.
entries.failures: No numerical reproduction failure. Three local-path metadata cells were replaced by basenames before qualification; all scientific field strings retained. Private corruption and overwrite fixtures were correctly rejected.
entries.next_steps: Push and verify this new repository only. Complete older-analysis archive coverage and owner-approved licence/visibility decisions before a public release and DOI.
entries.scope: Repository-preparation milestone, not a new scientific experiment or a completed public archive.
